title.en: Steps for problem solving and algorithms

hook.en: A recipe tells you exactly what to do, in what order, and when you are done. A computer needs the same kind of recipe for every problem. We call it an algorithm.
hook.kn: ಅಡುಗೆ ವಿಧಾನ ಏನು ಮಾಡಬೇಕು, ಯಾವ ಕ್ರಮದಲ್ಲಿ, ಯಾವಾಗ ಮುಗಿಯಿತು ಎಂದು ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿ ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗೂ ಗಣಕಯಂತ್ರಕ್ಕೆ ಇಂತಹದೇ ವಿಧಾನ ಬೇಕು. ಅದೇ ಕ್ರಮಾವಳಿ.

objectives.en: List the steps of problem solving
State the characteristics of a good algorithm

narration.en: A recipe tells you exactly what to do, in what order, and when you are done. A computer needs the same kind of recipe for every problem. We call it an algorithm.
narration.kn: ಅಡುಗೆ ವಿಧಾನ ಏನು ಮಾಡಬೇಕು, ಯಾವ ಕ್ರಮದಲ್ಲಿ, ಯಾವಾಗ ಮುಗಿಯಿತು ಎಂದು ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿ ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗೂ ಗಣಕಯಂತ್ರಕ್ಕೆ ಇಂತಹದೇ ವಿಧಾನ ಬೇಕು. ಅದೇ ಕ್ರಮಾವಳಿ.

body.en: Problem solving is the process of identifying a problem, developing an algorithm for it and implementing the algorithm as a program. The steps are: (1) analysing the problem, to understand the inputs and the expected outputs; (2) developing an algorithm, a step-by-step solution in plain language; (3) coding, writing the algorithm in a programming language; and (4) testing and debugging, running the program on different inputs and fixing errors.

narration.en: Problem solving is the process of identifying a problem, developing an algorithm for it and implementing the algorithm as a program. The steps are: (1) analysing the problem, to understand the inputs and the expected outputs; (2) developing an algorithm, a step-by-step solution in plain language; (3) coding, writing the algorithm in a programming language; and (4) testing and debugging, running the program on different inputs and fixing errors.
narration.kn: ಸಮಸ್ಯೆ ಪರಿಹಾರದ ಹಂತಗಳು: (1) ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಯ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆ — ಒಳಹರಿವು ಮತ್ತು ಹೊರಹರಿವು ಅರಿಯುವುದು; (2) ಕ್ರಮಾವಳಿ ರಚನೆ; (3) ಕೋಡಿಂಗ್ — ಪ್ರೋಗ್ರಾಮಿಂಗ್ ಭಾಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬರೆಯುವುದು; (4) ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಮತ್ತು ದೋಷ ನಿವಾರಣೆ.

title.en: On the board: The problem-solving cycle

say.en: First we analyse the problem: what are the inputs and what output do we expect?
Then we develop an algorithm: clear steps that solve it.
We code the algorithm in a programming language.
Then we test and debug. If the output is wrong, we go back and correct the earlier steps.
A good algorithm has precision, uniqueness and finiteness, and it has clear input and output.

narration.en: We draw the four steps of problem solving as a cycle and list what makes a good algorithm.

body.en: An algorithm is a finite sequence of clear steps that solves a problem. A good algorithm has precision (each step is clearly defined), uniqueness (the result of each step depends only on its input and the previous steps), finiteness (it stops after a finite number of steps), input (it takes zero or more inputs) and output (it produces at least one result).

narration.en: An algorithm is a finite sequence of clear steps that solves a problem. A good algorithm has precision (each step is clearly defined), uniqueness (the result of each step depends only on its input and the previous steps), finiteness (it stops after a finite number of steps), input (it takes zero or more inputs) and output (it produces at least one result).
narration.kn: ಕ್ರಮಾವಳಿ ಎಂದರೆ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆ ಬಿಡಿಸುವ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ ಹಂತಗಳ ಸೀಮಿತ ಅನುಕ್ರಮ. ಉತ್ತಮ ಕ್ರಮಾವಳಿಯ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳು: ನಿಖರತೆ, ಅನನ್ಯತೆ, ಸೀಮಿತತೆ, ಒಳಹರಿವು ಮತ್ತು ಹೊರಹರಿವು.

problem.en: Write an algorithm to find the GCD (HCF) of 45 and 54 using repeated remainders, and trace it.

steps.en: Step 1: Input two numbers A = 54 and B = 45.
Step 2: Find R = A mod B. 54 mod 45 = 9.
Step 3: If R = 0, output B and stop; else set A = B, B = R and repeat Step 2. Now A = 45, B = 9: 45 mod 9 = 0.
Step 4: R is 0, so output B = 9.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. Write an algorithm to find the GCD (HCF) of 45 and 54 using repeated remainders, and trace it.

heading.en: Five marks of a good algorithm

body.en: A good algorithm must be clear, give one result, end, take input and give output.

narration.en: Five marks of a good algorithm. A good algorithm must be clear, give one result, end, take input and give output.

mnemonic.en: PUFIO: Precision, Uniqueness, Finiteness, Input, Output
